[Verse 1]
[C]Early in the evenin' just
[G]about supper time, [C]
Over by the courthouse they're
[G]starting to unwind. [C]
[F]Four kids on the corner
[C]trying to bring you up.
Willy picks a tune out and he
[G]blows it on the harp. [C]

[Chorus]
[F]Down on the [C]corner,
[G]out in the street [C]Willy and the
[F]Poorboys are [C]playin' Bring a nic-
[G]kel; tap your feet. [C]

[Verse 2]
[C]Rooster hits the washboard and
[G]people just got to smile, [C]
Blinky, thumps the gut bass and
[G]solos for a while. [C]
[F]Poorboy twangs the rhythm out
[C]on his kalamazoo. And
Willy goes into a dance and
[G]doubles on kazoo. [C]

[F]Down on the [C]corner,

if you've got a nickel, won't you

[C]there's a happy noise.
People come from all around to
